what: The prewarm asks for every page the cache holds of the path's file, and a file written whole by a first link is held whole, so each later clone is asked for all of the image's data again (hello world: about 1100 pages, 18 MB, a path an edit) though a run touches 755. `mincore`'s referenced bit is set for read-ahead pages too on macOS, so the pages a run touched cannot be told from those only read ahead.
cost: 18 MB of read-ahead a path an edit, off the answer's path; capped at 256 MiB for a large image
cause: the system says what is in memory, not what was used
state: open: remember the ranges the last runs faulted (the daemon's dev-run hook could say), or lower the cap once measured on a large image
